packageRules.description: CoreDNS is pinned as a build arg rather than a base image, so point Renovate at the GitHub release tags. A bump here rebuilds the plugin against a new CoreDNS; the plugin tests are what catch an API change.
Go module updates for the plugin itself. These are all CoreDNS's own dependencies, so let them batch.
Never open a PR that unpins an image tag.

customManagers.description: The COREDNS_VERSION build arg in the Dockerfile
